newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts' bullish tone intact above 114-20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts' bullish tone intact above 114-20.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures will remain bullish on Monday while they hold above 114-20, technical analysts said.
"There is a lot of reasonable support around for today and the general outlook is bullish." said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
"The contract will look pretty good today while above 114-20 for a push on the (recent) highs. It might be difficult to bust through there today but if it does 115-15 is the next target."
At 0714 GMT September gilt futures were at 114-24, unchanged from Friday's close.
On a long term view gilts were in the middle of a powerful range betwen 114-30 to 115-05 on the upside and 113-26 to 113-22 at the base, Wood said.

He said the contract had done well to hold above the lower end of the range after the British budget last Wednesday and had made an impressive recovery on Friday. If it did slip through 114-20 on Monday, Wood said there was a good short-term support area from 114-10 down to 114-04 from where he would expect a rally.
"The most important suport is at 113-26 to 113-22 and below there and we are in trouble," said Wood.
"But that is quite a long way off and we probably won't get down there today."
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures also said critical support was at 113-22.
But he said the rejection of 115-00 area on Thursday would keep up the pressure to the downside.
"We remain of the opinion that further pressure can build to see tests again of supports with breaks opening the way for retreats down to 113-03," Adcock said in a research note.
At the short end December short sterling was at 92.65, up one basis point from Friday's close.
